response.description: Your AI coding agents just got smarter about building high-performance database applications. The Azure Cosmos DB Agent Kit is now generally available, bringing proven best practices directly into your development workflow. Whether you're designing data models, optimizing queries, or architecting globally distributed applications, your agents now have the expertise to guide every decision. With more than 100 actionable rules covering everything from partition key strategies to SDK optimization patterns, the Agent Kit helps you avoid common performance pitfalls and build applications that scale efficiently from day one. Your agents understand the nuances of Cosmos DB, helping you to prevent hot partitions, determine which queries will cause runaway costs, and configure resilience for production workloads. You benefit from faster development, fewer performance surprises, and applications that work smarter with your database. The Agent Kit integrates seamlessly into your coding workflow, providing real-time guidance whether you're in Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot, or your favorite AI coding environment. You can learn best practices faster, make the right architectural choices, and catch optimization opportunities earlier. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Agent kit for Azure Cosmos DB
